Monsoon is just around the corner — and in Ayurveda, this is the most important season for your health.

Most people don't know this: the rainy season weakens your digestive fire, drops your immunity, and makes your body more vulnerable to infections, joint pain, and skin issues. It's not bad luck — it's biology.

This is exactly why Panchakarma was traditionally done before monsoon arrives.

At Siddhayu Ayurvedic Clinic, we help your body:

✅ Flush out accumulated toxins (Ama) before the season hits
✅ Strengthen immunity from the inside out
✅ Balance Vata & Pitta — the doshas most aggravated in monsoon

Don't wait until you're already sick to think about your health.
